properties.name: Dublin/Pleasanton
properties.geometry_method: traced: Valley Link Rail Project Draft Subsequent EIR, Chapter 2, Project Description (April 2024, SCH 2018092027), PDF p. 18, Figure 2-13, Dublin/Pleasanton Station: centre of the 'Elevated Valley Link Platform'.
properties.notes: A new double-track aerial Valley Link platform south of eastbound I-580, beside the existing BART station (its centre is 113 m from BART's platform stop). Transfers are through the BART station concourse.

properties.notes: A new at-grade platform in the I-580 median east of Isabel Avenue, with parking south of the freeway.

properties.name: Vasco Road

properties.notes: New Valley Link platforms beside the existing Vasco Road ACE platform, for cross-platform transfers (the figure's platform centre is 75 m from Caltrans' ACE stop point).
